name: azure-finops
description: Read-only Azure FinOps pack for Azure SRE Agent: eleven skills covering managed-scope enforcement, cost anomalies, rightsizing, allocation, budget governance, AI spend, cost vs reliability, executive rollups and deterministic Live Report rendering. Say "Set up FinOps for me" and finops-setup does everything: it grants the agent's read-only cost roles on behalf of the signed-in user (one approval), creates the seven scheduled reports, and produces the first Live Report. Budget planning only produces a script for a human to review and run.
